entries.name: Face Analysis
entries.description: A round-the-clock audience analyst for your store: builds hourly visitor profiles by gender and age group and reads emotional feedback, informing product selection, displays and campaigns. Analysis stays on the device — no face images leave the camera.
entries.description_zh: 为门店打造的 24 小时客流分析师：按小时统计访客的性别与年龄结构，读取情绪反馈，为选品、陈列和活动提供依据。分析全程在设备本地完成，人脸图像不会离开摄像头。

entries.name: PP-OCR Text Reader
entries.description: Turn the camera into a tireless data-entry clerk: meter readings, container codes, shipping labels, station tags — point and read, in Chinese and English, with results flowing straight into your system. No more manual transcription.
entries.description_zh: 把摄像头变成不知疲倦的“录入员”：仪表读数、集装箱号、面单编号、工位标签，对准即读、中英文皆可，识别结果直接进系统，告别人工抄录和录入错误。

entries.name: Hand Gesture Recognition
entries.description: A contact-free interaction assistant for care settings: the full MediaPipe hand pipeline on the NPU — palm detection, 21-point landmarks, embedding and gesture classification — recognises 8 gestures (open palm, fist, thumbs up and more) and streams results with video over UDP. Touchless calling, bed-exit signals and routine checks, no wearables needed.
entries.description_zh: 照护场景的免接触交互助手：NPU 上运行完整 MediaPipe 手部流水线——手掌检测、21 点关键点、嵌入与手势分类——识别 8 种手势（张掌、握拳、竖大拇指等），结果与画面经 UDP 推流。无需穿戴即可实现呼叫、离床提示与日常巡查。
